source: quality delivery cycles 2-3 journal rows + orchestrator run evidence r1-r5

failures.failure: 30s default child timeout declared real build work reconciliation-required (run r1); read-only children share the fail-closed path even though no effects can have landed
failures.rootCause: request.timeoutMs default tuned for in-process fixtures; timeout catch does not distinguish read-only from side-effecting children
failures.fix: driver realMode passes 600s and honors --timeout-ms; runtime: read-only child timeout now returns typed retryable failure (class timeout, code child-timeout); side-effecting children keep fail-closed reconciliation

failures.failure: approval binding mismatch when caller passed --run-id diverging from approach.runId
failures.rootCause: approvals bind to phase.runId (approach identity) while orchestrate accepted any parent runId
failures.fix: orchestrate fails fast with a typed error when runId !== approach.runId; driver also guards

failures.failure: telemetry.jsonl empty for early runs (async transport writes lost on process exit)
failures.rootCause: no drain of the transport write queue before exit
failures.fix: telemetryEmitter.flush() drains the transport; orchestrate epilogue awaits it best-effort; driver also drains explicitly
failures.verifiedBy: tests/orchestrate-honest-failures.test.mjs flush assertion + r5 run telemetry (12 events)

failures.failure: stale csm-upload capability digest shipped in 9e9fb05 and surfaced only as an orchestrator startup failure two cycles later
failures.rootCause: no gate-time verification of capabilities.json digests against skill file bytes
failures.fix: check-suite capability manifest freshness check (per-skill sha256 + entrypoint libraryDigest)
failures.verifiedBy: make check includes the new gate; negative behavior demonstrated by the original 9e9fb05 incident

failures.failure: hardcoded contentDigest pin in orchestrate-capabilities.test.mjs broke on the legitimate manifest regeneration
failures.rootCause: pin asserted a constant instead of manifest self-consistency
failures.fix: pin replaced with computed consistency assertion

failures.failure: driver silently reused durable run state; surfaced as progress fencing staleness (run r2)
failures.fix: driver refuses to start when durable state exists unless --resume is passed
failures.verifiedBy: manual rerun behavior + guard code review (runbook: fresh runId per attempt)

failures.failure: host parity check targeted the package entry instead of lib/index.mjs (run r3 host throw)
failures.rootCause: host author error; the runtime contract was correct
failures.fix: fixed in cycle 3 host; recorded as honesty evidence

failures.failure: piped node --test does not echo subprocess stdout, so a host-level VERIFIED regex on captured output can never match (run r4)
failures.rootCause: test-runner reporter behavior; assertion placed at the wrong layer
failures.fix: wiring test asserts the VERIFIED receipt itself; host derives from test pass/fail counts
failures.verifiedBy: cycle 3 run VERIFIED + wiring test green

failures.failure: persisted independent-review records unresolvable by host-only parent resolvers (wiring test BLOCKED invalid-review-artifact)
failures.rootCause: runtime review records are files; host in-memory resolvers cannot see them
failures.fix: driver composes host resolver with the real file-backed resolver over reviewArtifactRoot

failures.failure: csm-orchestrate/lib/index.mjs exceeded the 60kB maintainability outlier threshold (73938 bytes)
failures.fix: split into run-helpers/run-artifacts/run-cursor with public API parity (cycle 3 item 4)
